description: Use when an agent needs a sourced answer to a question from the live web in one call. Input: q (question), optional time_range (day, week, month, year). Output: JSON answer (English, inline [n] citations), citations [{url, title, quote}], confidence, notes, sources read. Searches, reads the top 4 pages itself and answers only from them. Provider or model failure is not charged. Example: ?q=what+is+the+x402+payment+protocol Price: $0.012 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

time_range.description: Only results from the past day, week, month or year

name: web_answer
title: Web answer with citations: search, read the top pages, answer in JSON with source quotes
